user.title: BRUH Claude
user.description:
Connect to the BRUH Claude Terminal app. Make sure the app is installed and running before continuing.

You can add multiple entries with different names and system prompts to create different personalities.

data_description.name: The name shown in Settings > Voice Assistants (e.g. 'BRUH Claude', 'Sarcastic Assistant').
data_description.model: Which Claude model this agent uses. Sonnet is fast and balanced, Opus is the most capable, Haiku is the fastest and cheapest.
data_description.system_prompt: Optional system prompt that defines this agent's personality. Leave blank for the default assistant behavior.
data_description.timeout: Maximum time in seconds to wait for Claude to respond.

hassio_confirm.title: BRUH Claude Discovered
hassio_confirm.description: The BRUH Claude Terminal app has been detected. Do you want to set up the BRUH Claude integration?

error.addon_not_running: The BRUH Claude Terminal app does not appear to be running. Start the app and try again.

init.title: BRUH Claude Options
init.description: Adjust the model, system prompt, and timeout for this conversation agent.

data_description.model: Which Claude model this agent uses. Sonnet is fast and balanced, Opus is the most capable, Haiku is the fastest and cheapest.
data_description.system_prompt: Optional system prompt that defines this agent's personality. Leave blank for the default assistant behavior.
data_description.timeout: Maximum time in seconds to wait for Claude to respond.

confirm.title: Restart Home Assistant
confirm.description:
The BRUH Claude integration has been updated to version {version}. Home Assistant will restart to load the new version.

This will briefly interrupt all automations and connections.
